title: Migrate a 10,000-line generated record-class module to its v2 wire format, class by class
prompt:
models.py in the current directory holds our generated fleet API record classes (about 10,000 lines: 220 classes, each with __init__, to_dict and from_dict). The generator is gone, so the file has to be migrated in place to the v2 wire format that MIGRATION.md describes: every record class, with the enum table, the deprecated classes and the per-class exceptions it lists. Behaviour the document does not change must stay exactly as it is.

tests/test_models.py has examples of the v2 behaviour for a few classes; run them from this directory with `/usr/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. More tests than these check every class.

Code must run on /usr/bin/python3 (Python 3.9), the interpreter the checks use; standard library only. Do not modify MIGRATION.md or tests/test_models.py.
